one_line: Royal physician of Magadha and healer in the early Buddhist world.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s, lean but well-toned, upright posture from disciplined training.
appearance.face: Oval face, medium-brown North Indian complexion, sharp observant eyes, straight nose, neatly trimmed short beard and moustache; default expression calm, thoughtful, with a slight knowing half-smile.
appearance.hair: Straight dark brown-black hair, medium length, combed back from the forehead and tied into a small low knot at the back of the head; no turban, but a simple narrow off-white cloth headband encircling the crown and knotted discreetly behind the left ear.
appearance.costume: He wears a Magadhan-style wrapped cotton outfit: a knee-length off-white angavastra robe wrapped left over right across the chest and secured with a thin brown cloth belt at the waist, the robe’s lower portion falling as straight pleats to mid-calf; over this drapes a soft light-ochre upper cloth (uttariya) from the left shoulder diagonally across the back and under the right arm so it can be swung forward when examining patients; underneath, a simple off-white dhoti is tied securely and visible at the ankles; his feet are in plain dark brown leather sandals with toe strap; textiles are undyed or lightly dyed, with very subtle narrow brown border lines at the edges of the uttariya and belt, no ornate patterns to emphasize his modest, practical status as a healer.
appearance.signature: A small, well-crafted dark-wood diagnostic kit: a rectangular hand-sized box carried in his right hand, its lid tied with a thin cord, from which protrudes the end of a neatly rolled palm-leaf medical notebook; when opened (for action panels) it holds a few simple bronze instruments and herb bundles, but on the sheet it remains closed.

ref_desc: Jivaka Komarabhacca is a lean late-twenties North Indian man with an oval medium-brown face, small knot-tied dark hair and headband, wearing off-white wrapped robes with a light-ochre shoulder cloth and brown belt, dark leather sandals, and carrying a dark-wood medical box with palm-leaf scroll.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Jivaka Komarabhacca: a lean late-twenties North Indian man with an oval medium-brown face, sharp observant eyes, straight nose, and a neatly trimmed short beard and moustache, his expression calm and thoughtful with a slight knowing half-smile. His straight dark brown-black hair is combed back and tied into a small knot low at the back of his head, encircled by a simple narrow off-white cloth headband knotted just behind the left ear. He wears a historically grounded early Buddhist Magadhan outfit: a knee-length off-white wrapped cotton angavastra robe crossing left over right across the chest, secured with a thin brown cloth belt at the waist, the lower part falling in straight pleats to mid-calf. Over this, a soft light-ochre uttariya (upper cloth) drapes from the left shoulder diagonally across his back and under the right arm, so it can be swung forward when working, while a plain off-white dhoti is tied underneath and visible at the ankles. His feet are in simple dark brown leather sandals with a toe strap. Borders of his garments have only subtle narrow brown lines, with no ornate decoration to emphasize modest practicality. In his right hand he carries his signature dark-wood diagnostic kit: a rectangular hand-sized box with a tied lid, the end of a rolled palm-leaf medical notebook protruding from one side; the box is closed and clearly visible. Use a restrained palette of off-white, light ochre, medium brown, dark brown, and a muted dark grey-brown for shadows, and present him front, back, and three-quarter views to show hair, headband, robe wrapping, shoulder cloth drape, belt, sandals, and the medical box consistently.
